scripts.script:
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Events")

    if actionType == "Dodge" and typeof(key) == "string" and key ~= "" then
        task.wait(0.05)
        Remotes.Dodge:FireServer(key)
    end
end)
